verdict.rationale: Web data-gathering APIs can plausibly ship autonomous research agents with selectable effort tiers, so this axis applies to Jina Reader. The evidence shows no agent mode and no low/medium/high reasoning-effort control. The nearest items are `x-respond-timing` (a latency-versus-completeness fetch control), the `research` preset (an output-format bundle) and `s.jina.ai` (a fixed fetch of the top 5 results), and none of these sets how much effort an agent spends reasoning.
